# Etsy Listing Audit — Delivery Template

> Customer-specific report. Replace every bracketed field. Do not leave unverified assumptions as facts.

## 1. Scope

- Customer/listing: [public listing URL]
- Product type: [verified product type]
- Target market/language: [market and language]
- Review date: [UTC date]
- Scope: one listing, up to five public competitors
- Limitations: public-page review only; no shop access or paid search-volume tools

## 2. Executive summary

- Strongest existing element: [evidence]
- Most important opportunity: [evidence]
- Main uncertainty: [what cannot be established from public sources]

## 10. Sources and limitations

List every public source URL, access date and the specific fact observed. Distinguish:
- Observed fact
- Interpretation
- Recommendation
- Unknown / not independently verifiable

No promise of search ranking, traffic, sales or conversion improvement. Etsy search also considers factors outside the scope of this audit.
